summary: Self-review of the new web marketplace Firestore rules and callable boundary: server-controlled writes, explicit trainer membership, verified active participant reads, and separate private content. Existing mobile predicates remain unchanged. Emulator attack and mobile compatibility suites pass; deployed authenticated smoke testing remains a release gate.

checks.result: All client create/update/delete operations on marketplace records are denied. Callable schemas and transactions validate mutations.
Authority comes from verified Firebase Auth and server-owned active membership/user records, never client-supplied role or ownership fields.
Owner inbox queries and unlocked participant message queries are allowed. Private introductions are Functions-only, notes are trainer-only, and existing mobile rules tests pass.
Writes use strict bounded schemas, per-user rate limits, text/array caps and validated 5 MB image/evidence limits. Storage client access remains denied.
Zod validates server-controlled writes, including enums, versions, dates and bounded strings. Rules require verified Auth and exact active/unlocked server fields.
Reads require exact owner or participant identity. No field allowlist grants cross-user mutation. Rules tests reject stranger reads, forged memberships and private-note access.
